Orbit and Figure-Eight Through Two Flows

The same sketch through three flows: the pin-trained xswap reading it from the source, SDEdit initialising the unpinned scratch3 from the sketch chunk at t0 = 0.3, and the unpinned scratch3 with the sketch injected into its source (no training-time constraint); the figure-eight section also carries the real-only pin. Five trials each. The mocap-frame origin is drawn with 0.5 m axes: x red, y green, z blue. Tables give each flight's closest approach to a gate post; the route judge does not apply to these motion programs.
